policy: Use all eight preserved 1024-byte windows and every 128-byte interval. Measure final-block input-weight, input-bias and leak gradients for unit spike-activity and direct membrane costs, normalized over time, neurons and all layers. No source, checkpoint or outcome-based case selection.
purpose: Determine whether a seemingly small membrane penalty can already exceed the saved gradient clip in a subset of parameter coordinates. No learning coefficient is chosen by this diagnostic.
